theorem mvcc.idxWriterSealed_commit (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change)
    (hlen : List.length ilog + 2 < 2 ^ 63) : ⊢ mvcc.idxWriterSealed γ ilog pend -∗ mvcc.idxLogAuth γ
    (Qp.half 1) ilog ==∗ mvcc.idxWriter γ (ilog ++ [pend]) [] ∗ mvcc.idxLogAuth γ (Qp.half 1) (ilog
    ++ [pend]) ∗ mvcc.idxCert γ (ilog ++ [pend])

def mvcc.IdxWf (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) : Prop :=
  mvcc.LogWf' (ilog ++ [pend]) ∧
    List.length ilog + 1 < 2 ^ 63 ∧ pend.length < 2 ^ 63 ∧ ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ ilog → cs.length < 2 ^ 63

theorem mvcc.idxSealed_pure (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (log : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.idxSealed γ log ⊢
    ⌜mvcc.LogWf' log ∧ List.length log < 2 ^ 63 ∧ ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log → cs.length <
    2 ^ 63⌝

theorem mvcc.Change.enc_inj : Function.Injective mvcc.Change.enc

theorem mvcc.idxSealed_prefix (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (log log' : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.idxSealed γ log ∗
    mvcc.idxSealed γ log' ⊢ ⌜log <+: log' ∨ log' <+: log⌝

theorem mvcc.idxWriterB_false (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) :
    mvcc.idxWriterB γ ilog pend false = mvcc.idxWriter γ ilog pend

theorem mvcc.ownBTree_split' {T' : Type} [ZeroVal T'] [TypedPointsto T'] (T : go.GoType)
    [IntoValTyped T' T] {V : Type} (t : Loc) (isItem : T' → V → IProp GF) [∀ (p : T') (v : V),
    Persistent (isItem p v)] (less : V → V → Prop) (items : List V) (dq1 dq2 : DFrac) : ownBTree T t
    isItem less items (dq1 • dq2) ⊢ ownBTree T t isItem less items dq1 ∗ ownBTree T t isItem less
    items dq2

def mvcc.idxCmpOwn (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (q : Qp) (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) (cmax : Int) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ cc P,
      ghostVar γ.cmp q.half (cc, P) ∗ ⌜cmax ≤ cc ∧ (∀ (p : Loc), p ∈ P → p ∈ List.map Prod.fst L) ∧ (P ≠ [] → 0 ≤ cmax)⌝)

theorem mvcc.idxSealed_cmp (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (log log' : mvcc.Log) : ⊢ mvcc.idxSealed γ log -∗
    mvcc.idxSealed γ log' -∗ ⌜log <+: log' ∨ log' <+: log⌝

def mvcc.crevLb (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (c : Int) : IProp GF :=
  monoNatLbOwn γ.crev (mvcc.crevN c)

def mvcc.idxFresh (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(monoListAuthOwn γ.hist 1 [] ∗
      monoListLbOwn γ.hist [] ∗
        monoNatAuthOwn γ.nev 1 0 ∗
          monoNatLbOwn γ.nev 0 ∗
            monoListAuthOwn γ.log 1 [] ∗
              monoListLbOwn γ.log [] ∗ monoNatAuthOwn γ.crev 1 0 ∗ monoNatLbOwn γ.crev 0 ∗ ghostVar γ.cmp 1 (-1, []))

def mvcc.idxWriterSealed (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) : IProp GF
    :=
  iprop(monoListAuthOwn γ.hist 1 (mvcc.histOf (ilog ++ [pend])) ∗
      monoNatLbOwn γ.nev (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend])).length ∗
        ⌜mvcc.IdxWf ilog pend ∧ pend ≠ []⌝ ∗ mvcc.idxLogAuth γ (Qp.half 1) ilog ∗ ⧖(mvcc.logCh ilog + pend.length))

theorem mvcc.LogWf'.append_nil {log : mvcc.Log} (h : mvcc.LogWf' log) (hne : log ≠ []) : mvcc.LogWf'
    (log ++ [[]])

theorem mvcc.idxCmpOwn_combine (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) (c1 c2 : Int) (q1 q2 :
    Qp) : mvcc.idxCmpOwn γ q1 L c1 ∗ mvcc.idxCmpOwn γ q2 L c2 ⊢ mvcc.idxCmpOwn γ (q1 + q2) L c1

def mvcc.isTreeIndex (ti : Loc) (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ t lg,
      "#Htree" ∷
          typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.treeIndex go!"tree" ti)
            t DFrac.discard ∗
        "#Hlg" ∷
            typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.treeIndex go!"lg" ti) lg
              DFrac.discard ∗
          "#Hlgnn" ∷ zapLoggerOk lg ∗ "#Hmu" ∷ sync.isRWMutexGuard (mvcc.idxMuAddr ti) (mvcc.idxLockInv t γ))

    mvcc.idxWriter γ ilog pend ⊣⊢ mvcc.idxWriterNR γ ilog pend ∗ ⧖(mvcc.logCh ilog + pend.length)

theorem mvcc.IdxWf.sealed {ilog : mvcc.Log} {pend : List mvcc.Change} (h : mvcc.IdxWf ilog pend) :
    mvcc.LogWf' (ilog ++ [pend]) ∧ List.length (ilog ++ [pend]) < 2 ^ 63 ∧ ∀ (cs : List
    mvcc.Change), cs ∈ ilog ++ [pend] → cs.length < 2 ^ 63

def mvcc.ownEntry (z : mvcc.IdxEntry) (q : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜z.fst ≠ null⌝ ∗ ∃ gs, mvcc.ownKi z.fst gs z.snd.snd (DFrac.own q))

def mvcc.idxLockInv (t : Loc) (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (q : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ilog pend L cmax,
      "#Hhist" ∷ monoListLbOwn γ.hist (mvcc.histShape ilog pend) ∗
        "Hnev" ∷ monoNatAuthOwn γ.nev q (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend])).length ∗
          "Htree" ∷ mvcc.ownTree t L q ∗
            "#Hcrev" ∷ mvcc.crevLb γ cmax ∗
              ("#Hcl" ∷ ∃ log₀, monoListLbOwn γ.log log₀ ∗ ⌜cmax < ↑(List.length log₀)⌝) ∗
                "%HL" ∷ ⌜mvcc.IdxCRepN cmax (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend])) (mvcc.idxOfEntries L) ∧ -1 ≤ cmax⌝ ∗
                  "%Hwf" ∷ ⌜mvcc.IdxWf ilog pend⌝ ∗ "Hcmp" ∷ mvcc.idxCmpOwn γ q L cmax)

def mvcc.crevUB (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (q : Qp) (c : Int) : IProp GF :=
  monoNatAuthOwn γ.crev q (mvcc.crevN c)

def mvcc.idxNevLb (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (log : mvcc.Log) : IProp GF :=
  monoNatLbOwn γ.nev (mvcc.evsOf log).length

def mvcc.idxMuAddr [GoSemanticsFunctions] (ti : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.treeIndex go!"RWMutex" ti

    log)

    log) = iprop(mvcc.idxCert γ log ∗ mvcc.idxNevLb γ log)

    z) (h : z'.fst = z.fst) : List.map Prod.fst (L.set i z') = List.map Prod.fst L

    : mvcc.idxCmpOwn γ (q1 + q2) L cmax ⊢ mvcc.idxCmpOwn γ q1 L cmax ∗ mvcc.idxCmpOwn γ q2 L cmax

    mvcc.idxCert γ log' ⊢ ⌜log <+: log' ∨ log' <+: log⌝

    mvcc.IdxEntry) : L[j]? = some z → ([∗list] y ∈ L, mvcc.ownEntry y q) ⊢ mvcc.ownEntry z q ∗
    [∗list] y ∈ L.eraseIdx j, mvcc.ownEntry y q

theorem mvcc.ownTree_keys (t : Loc) (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) (q : Qp) : mvcc.ownTree t L q ⊢
    mvcc.ownTree t L q ∗ □ ∀ z, ⌜z ∈ L⌝ -∗ mvcc.kiKey z.fst z.snd.fst

theorem mvcc.idxWriterB_nil (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (b : Bool) : mvcc.idxWriterB γ
    ilog [] b ⊢ mvcc.idxWriter γ ilog []

def mvcc.Ev.enc (e : mvcc.Ev) : mvcc.Rev × Bool × GoString × GoString × w64 :=
  (e.rev, e.change.enc)

inductive mvcc.IdxKnow : Type
  | mvcc.IdxKnow.cert (log : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.IdxKnow
  | mvcc.IdxKnow.writer (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) : mvcc.IdxKnow

def mvcc.Change.countable : Pos.Countable mvcc.Change :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun c => Pos.Countable.encode c.enc) mvcc.Change.countable._proof_1

theorem mvcc.idxNevLb_persistent (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (log : mvcc.Log) : Persistent (mvcc.idxNevLb γ
    log)

theorem mvcc.ownGen_split (gv : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.generation) (gm : mvcc.Gen)
    (dq1 dq2 : DFrac) : mvcc.ownGen gv gm (dq1 • dq2) ⊢ mvcc.ownGen gv gm dq1 ∗ mvcc.ownGen gv gm
    dq2

theorem mvcc.idxCert_nil (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) : ⊢ |==> mvcc.idxCert γ []

theorem mvcc.idxKnows_facts (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (kn : mvcc.IdxKnow) (log : mvcc.Log) (hlog : kn.log
    = log) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (q : Qp) : ⊢ mvcc.idxKnows γ kn -∗
    monoListLbOwn γ.hist (mvcc.histShape ilog pend) -∗ monoNatAuthOwn γ.nev q (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++
    [pend])).length -∗ ⌜(mvcc.histOf log <+: mvcc.histShape ilog pend ∨ mvcc.histShape ilog pend <+:
    mvcc.histOf log) ∧ (mvcc.evsOf log).length ≤ (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend])).length ∧ mvcc.LogWf'
    log ∧ List.length log < 2 ^ 63 ∧ ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log → cs.length < 2 ^ 63⌝ ∗
    mvcc.idxKnows γ kn ∗ monoNatAuthOwn γ.nev q (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend])).length

theorem mvcc.idxWriter_lb (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.idxWriter γ ilog [] ⊢
    mvcc.idxWriter γ ilog [] ∗ mvcc.idxWriterLb γ ilog

def mvcc.HistItem.enc : mvcc.HistItem → Option mvcc.Ev :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.HistItem.ev e => some e
  | mvcc.HistItem.commit => none

theorem mvcc.ownTree_combine (t : Loc) (L1 L2 : List mvcc.IdxEntry) (q1 q2 : Qp) : ⊢ mvcc.ownTree t
    L1 q1 -∗ mvcc.ownTree t L2 q2 -∗ ⌜L1 = L2⌝ ∗ mvcc.ownTree t L1 (q1 + q2)

theorem mvcc.ownTree_sorted (t : Loc) (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) (q : Qp) : mvcc.ownTree t L q ⊢
    mvcc.ownTree t L q ∗ ⌜List.Pairwise mvcc.kiItemLess (mvcc.itemsOfEntries L)⌝

theorem mvcc.idxWriter_cert_prefix (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change)
    (log : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.idxWriter γ ilog pend ∗ mvcc.idxCert γ log ⊢ ⌜log <+: ilog⌝

def mvcc.Rev.enc (r : mvcc.Rev) : w64 × w64 :=
  (r.main, r.sub)

theorem mvcc.idxWriterB_true (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) :
    mvcc.idxWriterB γ ilog pend true = mvcc.idxWriterSealed γ ilog pend

theorem mvcc.ownKi_combine (p : Loc) (gs1 gs2 : GoSlice) (ki1 ki2 : mvcc.KeyIndex) (dq1 dq2 : DFrac)
    : ⊢ mvcc.ownKi p gs1 ki1 dq1 -∗ mvcc.ownKi p gs2 ki2 dq2 -∗ ⌜gs1 = gs2 ∧ ki1 = ki2⌝ ∗ mvcc.ownKi
    p gs1 ki1 (dq1 • dq2)

def mvcc.logCh (log : mvcc.Log) : Nat :=
  (List.map List.length log).sum

def mvcc.idxWriter (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(monoListAuthOwn γ.hist 1 (mvcc.histShape ilog pend) ∗
      monoNatLbOwn γ.nev (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend])).length ∗
        ⌜mvcc.IdxWf ilog pend⌝ ∗ mvcc.idxLogAuth γ (Qp.half 1) ilog ∗ ⧖(mvcc.logCh ilog + pend.length))

def mvcc.idxKnows (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) : mvcc.IdxKnow → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.IdxKnow.cert log => iprop(mvcc.idxCert γ log ∗ mvcc.idxNevLb γ log)
  | mvcc.IdxKnow.writer ilog pend => mvcc.idxWriter γ ilog pend

theorem mvcc.ownTree_entry (t : Loc) (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) (q : Qp) (z : mvcc.IdxEntry) (hz : z ∈
    L) : mvcc.ownTree t L q ⊢ mvcc.ownTree t L q ∗ ⌜z.fst ≠ null⌝ ∗ mvcc.kiKey z.fst z.snd.fst

def mvcc.idxCert (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (log : mvcc.Log) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(monoListLbOwn γ.hist (mvcc.histOf log) ∗
      ⌜mvcc.LogWf' log ∧ List.length log < 2 ^ 63 ∧ ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log → cs.length < 2 ^ 63⌝ ∗
        monoListLbOwn γ.log log ∗ ⧖(mvcc.logCh log))

def mvcc.ownTree (t : Loc) (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) (q : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜List.Pairwise mvcc.kiItemLess (mvcc.itemsOfEntries L)⌝ ∗
      ownBTree mvcc.kiPtrT t mvcc.kiItemIs mvcc.kiItemLess (mvcc.itemsOfEntries L) (DFrac.own q) ∗
        [∗list] z ∈ L, mvcc.ownEntry z q)

def mvcc.KiItem : Type :=
  Loc × GoString

def mvcc.idxWriterB (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (sealed : Bool)
    : IProp GF :=
  if sealed = true then mvcc.idxWriterSealed γ ilog pend else mvcc.idxWriter γ ilog pend

theorem mvcc.ownTree_fractional (t : Loc) (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) : Fractional fun q =>
    mvcc.ownTree t L q

theorem mvcc.idxFresh_alloc : ⊢ |==> ∃ γ, mvcc.idxFresh γ

theorem mvcc.bigSepL_ownEntry_insert (z0 : mvcc.IdxEntry) (q : Qp) (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) :
    (mvcc.ownEntry z0 q ∗ [∗list] z ∈ L, mvcc.ownEntry z q) ⊢ [∗list] z ∈ btInsert mvcc.entryLess z0
    L, mvcc.ownEntry z q

def mvcc.idxSealed (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (log : mvcc.Log) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(monoListLbOwn γ.hist (mvcc.histOf log) ∗
      ⌜mvcc.LogWf' log ∧ List.length log < 2 ^ 63 ∧ ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log → cs.length < 2 ^ 63⌝ ∗
        ⧖(mvcc.logCh log))

theorem mvcc.ownBTree_split_own {T' : Type} [ZeroVal T'] [TypedPointsto T'] (T : go.GoType)
    [IntoValTyped T' T] {V : Type} (t : Loc) (isItem : T' → V → IProp GF) [∀ (p : T') (v : V),
    Persistent (isItem p v)] (less : V → V → Prop) (items : List V) (q1 q2 : Qp) : ownBTree T t
    isItem less items (DFrac.own (q1 + q2)) ⊢ ownBTree T t isItem less items (DFrac.own q1) ∗
    ownBTree T t isItem less items (DFrac.own q2)

def mvcc.Change.enc : mvcc.Change → Bool × GoString × GoString × w64 :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.Change.put k v l => (false, k, v, l)
  | mvcc.Change.del k => (true, k, [], W64 0)

theorem mvcc.kiKey_agree (p : Loc) (k1 k2 : GoString) : ⊢ mvcc.kiKey p k1 -∗ mvcc.kiKey p k2 -∗ ⌜k1
    = k2⌝

theorem mvcc.ownGensL_split (dq1 dq2 : DFrac) (gvs : List
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.generation) (gens : List mvcc.Gen) : mvcc.ownGensL (dq1 •
    dq2) gvs gens ⊢ mvcc.ownGensL dq1 gvs gens ∗ mvcc.ownGensL dq2 gvs gens

theorem mvcc.idxSealed_rcpt (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (log : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.idxSealed γ log ⊢
    ⧖(mvcc.logCh log)

theorem mvcc.idxWriter_wf (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) :
    mvcc.idxWriter γ ilog pend ⊢ ⌜mvcc.IdxWf ilog pend⌝

theorem mvcc.map_revVal_inj (l1 l2 : List mvcc.Rev) : List.map mvcc.revVal l1 = List.map mvcc.revVal
    l2 → l1 = l2

theorem mvcc.idxCmpOwn_mono (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (q : Qp) (L L' : List mvcc.IdxEntry) (cmax : Int) (h
    : ∀ (p : Loc), p ∈ List.map Prod.fst L → p ∈ List.map Prod.fst L') : mvcc.idxCmpOwn γ q L cmax ⊢
    mvcc.idxCmpOwn γ q L' cmax

theorem mvcc.idxWriterLb_persistent (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) : Persistent
    (mvcc.idxWriterLb γ ilog)

theorem mvcc.ownGens_combine (gs : GoSlice) (gens1 gens2 : List mvcc.Gen) (dq1 dq2 : DFrac) : ⊢
    mvcc.ownGens gs gens1 dq1 -∗ mvcc.ownGens gs gens2 dq2 -∗ ⌜gens1 = gens2⌝ ∗ mvcc.ownGens gs
    gens1 (dq1 • dq2)

theorem mvcc.IdxKnow.log_writer (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) : (mvcc.IdxKnow.writer
    ilog pend).log = ilog ++ [pend]
